packageRules.description: typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet, see typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940
@types/node follows the Node version the workflows run, currently 22
The workflows are how this repository runs: keep their actions current
One pull request for the tooling rather than one per package
Nothing here ships to production, and the tests run on every branch: a minor, a patch or a digest merges itself once they pass. A major never does.
